---
title: "Folr2 correlates"
---

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))

dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "folr2_correlates"))
```

```{r}
so <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```

```{r}
so_ctrl <- subset(so %>% set_idents("group"), idents = "Ctrl__Isotype")
```

```{r}
so_ctrl <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so_ctrl)
DimPlot(so_ctrl %>% set_idents("clusters_M"), label = T) + 
  coord_fixed()
FeaturePlot(so_ctrl, features = c("Folr2"))
```

```{r}
genes <- read_excel(here("data", "Folr2_correlation_markers.xlsx"), col_names = F)[[1]]

genes <- genes[-which(genes == "Mx1")]
genes <- genes[-which(genes == "Cxcl11")]
```

```{r}
folr2_df <- get_gene_expr_from_so(so_ctrl, gene_vec = c("Folr2", "Mki67"))
genes_df <- get_gene_expr_from_so(so_ctrl, gene_vec = genes)
genes_df <- folr2_df %>% left_join(genes_df, by = "cell")
genes_tidy <- genes_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.))
genes_list <- named_group_split(genes_tidy, name)
```

```{r}
for (gene_str in names(genes_list)) {
  print(gene_str)
  
  pdf(
    file.path(results_dir, "folr2_correlates", paste0(gene_str, ".pdf")),
    height = 3,
    width = 3
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(genes_list[[gene_str]]) +
    aes(log1p(value), log1p(Folr2)) +
    geom_scattermore(pointsize = 4.1,
                     alpha = 0.7,
                     pixels = c(1024, 1024)) +
    stat_cor() +
    stat_smooth() +
    labs(x = sprintf("log1p(%s)", gene_str), 
         title = gene_str) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  print(p)
  
  dev.off()
}
```

## Just Cluster 3 M2-like macs subset

```{r}
so_m2 <- subset(so_ctrl %>% set_idents("clusters_M"), idents = "3: M2-like mac")
```

